Soil Organic Carbon (absSOC). This map shows the spatially continuous absolute SOC content in a 10x10m raster by using a Sentinel-2 time series. As SOC content shows fine-scaled variability, a higher resolution is required than what is available from soil probing, which is a 3-5ha raster. The map is calibrated with in-situ soil probes with an accuracy comparable to the laboratory.

Relative Soil Organic Carbon (relSOC). This map shows the spatially continuous relative SOC content in a 10x10m raster derived from a Sentinel-2 time series. It shows where SOC is higher or lower within and between fields, without calibration to absolute values.

Stratification for Soil Probing (zonesSOC). This map shows the spatially continuous relative SOC content in a 10x10m raster including a zone map with homogeneous soil zones by using a Sentinel-2 time series. It is used to stratify the soil sampling, which is required for several certification standards. zonesSOC data for None.

Assessment of overall carbon binding in soil and biomass (OCB). This layer shows how much carbon is bound in biomass to complement information about carbon stored in soils. The algorithm combines S2 time series with physical crop growth modelling driven by meteorological data as well as the SOC content and crop rotation on the field.

Detection of catch crop planting (ex-post) (CCD). This layer shows the detection of catch crop planting by using Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 time series without any information from the customer other than the field boundaries. Fields visualized in green are verified as fields with catch crops, whereas fields visualized in brown are classified as fields without catch crops. Uncertain fields are coloured in ochre. Additionally, fields where no reliable catch crop detection is possible due to e.g. a lack of sufficient data are marked in grey.

Monitoring and reporting of catch crop development (live) (areaCCDev). This layer shows LAI and biomass estimation in a 10x10m raster twice a month, making it available as a time series throughout the season.

Catch crop occurrence on arable parcels in Czechia (Sentinel-2 tile 33UVR) for 2021, 2022 and 2023. Green parcels had a catch crop after the main crop, red parcels did not. Use the time control to switch year.

This interactive map shows field boundaries across all major European Countries generated using the **Delineate Anything v2** algorithm applied to the 2025 summer season Sentinel-2 Global Mosaics (S2GM), with the WorldCereal 2021 map used as a delineation mask.

 To view the field boundaries, zoom in to a local in a country of your choice. The boundaries are displayed on the map when the scalebar in the bottom left displays 5 km or less.

**Please note** that the field boundaries are overlaid on high-resolution satellite imagery from the Stadia Maps service. As a result, some misalignment may be visible, since the boundaries were derived from Sentinel-2 data.

### Further information
Details of methodology are available on the [Delineate Anything Project Page](https://lavreniuk.github.io/Delineate-Anything/)
